name: TheBrain Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Does not count or write a note body with only white space.
Releases the selected export when the dialog closes during the file read.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A thought note that holds only blank space no longer adds an empty Notes heading or counts as a note body.
If you close the import dialog while it reads the export, the plugin no longer keeps the export in memory.
tip: You can import without a .brz archive. Select thoughts.json and links.json together in the file picker.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. TheBrain Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
